response.justification: Technically this candidate exceeds every hard requirement: 15+ years of fullstack work, deep TypeScript/Node.js and React experience, REST and web architecture fundamentals, AWS, Docker/Kubernetes, and current exposure to LLM/agent tooling — all nice-to-haves are covered. The problem is fit rather than capability: the role is explicitly entry level with a growth trajectory of 'progressively more responsibility,' and a Staff/Senior engineer with a founder background is likely to be misaligned on compensation, scope, and long-term retention. He is Berlin-based so the on-site requirement is workable, though only basic German may be a limitation in a German energy-consulting and construction domain. Worth a screening call purely to test motivation and salary expectations; if the team can flex the level upward, he is a strong hire, otherwise it is a mismatch.
strengths: Deep TypeScript/Node.js, React and fullstack breadth well beyond the bar
Covers all nice-to-haves: AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, LLM/agent tooling
Berlin-based with strong engineering-practice culture (TDD, CI/CD, mentoring)
concerns: Severely overqualified for an entry-level IC role; likely comp and scope mismatch
Database experience skews MongoDB; PostgreSQL/relational depth unproven
Only basic German for an on-site German construction/energy-consulting domain

key_factors.factor: Core stack match (TypeScript, React, Node, REST)
